Belgian Chocolate.author: Priya S.
Belgian Chocolate.text: Rich, creamy and super chocolaty. Hard to believe this is low calorie. My favourite late night treat!

Belgian Chocolate.author: Rahul M.
Belgian Chocolate.text: Loved it. Smooth texture and the chocolate tastes authentic, not fake. Will reorder.

Belgian Chocolate.author: Ananya K.
Belgian Chocolate.text: Very good taste for a guilt-free dessert. Slightly less creamy than regular ice cream but still delicious.

Belgian Chocolate.author: Vikram P.
Belgian Chocolate.text: The tub arrived half melted and refrozen, so it had ice crystals and a grainy texture. Disappointing.

Belgian Chocolate.author: Sneha R.
Belgian Chocolate.text: Best low sugar chocolate ice cream I have tried. Perfectly balanced sweetness.

Belgian Chocolate.author: Arjun T.
Belgian Chocolate.text: Decent, but the stick was small for the price. Taste is fine.

Cookies & Cream.author: Meera J.
Cookies & Cream.text: Amazing! Generous cookie chunks and very creamy. Totally worth it.

Cookies & Cream.author: Karan D.
Cookies & Cream.text: My kids love this one. Tastes like a premium brand without the sugar crash.

Cookies & Cream.author: Divya N.
Cookies & Cream.text: Really tasty, nice crunchy cookie bits. Would recommend.

Cookies & Cream.author: Siddharth G.
Cookies & Cream.text: Packaging was damaged and the lid was broken when delivered. Ice cream itself was okay.

Cookies & Cream.author: Pooja L.
Cookies & Cream.text: Absolutely yummy and refreshing. No weird aftertaste at all.

Madagascar Vanilla.author: Ritu A.
Madagascar Vanilla.text: Classic vanilla, smooth and pleasant. Good with brownies.

Madagascar Vanilla.author: Nikhil B.
Madagascar Vanilla.text: Too bland for me. Vanilla flavour is very subtle and it tastes a bit flat.

Madagascar Vanilla.author: Shalini V.
Madagascar Vanilla.text: Okay product. The sweetener aftertaste is noticeable in vanilla more than other flavours.

Madagascar Vanilla.author: Aditya C.
Madagascar Vanilla.text: Lovely real vanilla bean flavour, creamy and light. Great for diabetics in my family.

Madagascar Vanilla.author: Farah Q.
Madagascar Vanilla.text: Overpriced for a small cup. Not worth the money honestly.

Alphonso Mango.author: Harsh K.
Alphonso Mango.text: Melted completely during delivery and was refrozen. Icy and watery, very disappointing.

Alphonso Mango.author: Tanvi S.
Alphonso Mango.text: Mango tastes artificial and there is a strange chemical aftertaste. Would not buy again.

Alphonso Mango.author: Rohan W.
Alphonso Mango.text: Nice mango flavour, reminds me of aamras. Refreshing in summer.

Alphonso Mango.author: Isha P.
Alphonso Mango.text: Texture was icy with ice crystals everywhere. The texture ruined it.

Alphonso Mango.author: Manish Y.
Alphonso Mango.text: Average. Too sweet for a low sugar product and a bit sticky.

Alphonso Mango.author: Kavya R.
Alphonso Mango.text: Delicious! Tastes like real Alphonso. Loved it.

Alphonso Mango.author: Gaurav J.
Alphonso Mango.text: The stick broke in the packet and it was leaking. Poor packaging for summer delivery.

Salted Caramel.author: Neha B.
Salted Caramel.text: Heavenly! The salted caramel is perfectly balanced. Best flavour in the range.

Salted Caramel.author: Abhishek S.
Salted Caramel.text: Creamy, indulgent and not too sweet. Absolutely love it.

Salted Caramel.author: Lakshmi I.
Salted Caramel.text: Very tasty. A little pricey but worth it for a treat.

Salted Caramel.author: Varun M.
Salted Caramel.text: Addictive. Finished the whole tub in two days. Highly recommend.

Salted Caramel.author: Simran K.
Salted Caramel.text: Good flavour but the caramel swirl was lacking.

Strawberry Cheesecake.author: Aishwarya D.
Strawberry Cheesecake.text: Nice tangy cheesecake flavour with real strawberry bits. Pleasant.

Strawberry Cheesecake.author: Kunal R.
Strawberry Cheesecake.text: Strawberry tastes fake and too sugary. Did not enjoy it.

Strawberry Cheesecake.author: Bhavna T.
Strawberry Cheesecake.text: Lovely creamy cheesecake taste. My new favourite!

Strawberry Cheesecake.author: Mohit A.
Strawberry Cheesecake.text: The cheesecake part is barely there. Average and a bit bland overall.

Strawberry Cheesecake.author: Zoya H.
Strawberry Cheesecake.text: Refreshing and fruity, good for summer evenings.

Coffee Caramel Fudge.author: Deepak N.
Coffee Caramel Fudge.text: Coffee lovers must try. Strong coffee flavour with rich fudge. Excellent.

Coffee Caramel Fudge.author: Ira S.
Coffee Caramel Fudge.text: Very nice, smooth and not too sweet. Good quality.

Coffee Caramel Fudge.author: Prateek L.
Coffee Caramel Fudge.text: Bitter aftertaste from the coffee and sweetener combo. Not for me.

Coffee Caramel Fudge.author: Nandini G.
Coffee Caramel Fudge.text: Superb flavour. Tastes premium. Will buy again.

Hazelnut Crunch.author: Rhea M.
Hazelnut Crunch.text: Crunchy hazelnut bits and creamy base. Absolutely delicious.

Hazelnut Crunch.author: Aman V.
Hazelnut Crunch.text: Tastes like a healthier Nutella ice cream. Loved it.

Hazelnut Crunch.author: Sakshi J.
Hazelnut Crunch.text: Expensive for the quantity. The cup is tiny and half empty with air.

Hazelnut Crunch.author: Yash T.
Hazelnut Crunch.text: Fantastic flavour, good crunch. One of the best from Go Zero.

Hazelnut Crunch.author: Mitali P.
Hazelnut Crunch.text: Delivery was late and the cup had partly melted. Disappointing.

Blueberry Cheesecake.author: Parth K.
Blueberry Cheesecake.text: Good blueberry flavour, nice and tangy.

Blueberry Cheesecake.author: Anjali S.
Blueberry Cheesecake.text: Artificial blueberry taste and a chalky texture. Disappointed.

Blueberry Cheesecake.author: Ravi D.
Blueberry Cheesecake.text: Too sweet and sickly after a few spoons.

Blueberry Cheesecake.author: Juhi B.
Blueberry Cheesecake.text: Wonderful! Creamy and fruity, great combo.

Double Chocolate Brownie.author: Tarun G.
Double Chocolate Brownie.text: Decadent and chocolaty with real brownie chunks. Amazing for a low calorie treat.

Double Chocolate Brownie.author: Shreya A.
Double Chocolate Brownie.text: Best chocolate flavour. Rich and satisfying. Love it.

Double Chocolate Brownie.author: Imran K.
Double Chocolate Brownie.text: Very tasty and indulgent. Good value for money compared to other premium brands.

Double Chocolate Brownie.author: Payal N.
Double Chocolate Brownie.text: Brownie pieces were rock hard and gummy. Texture was poor.

Double Chocolate Brownie.author: Kabir S.
Double Chocolate Brownie.text: Wow, fantastic. Kids and adults both enjoyed it.

Mint Chocolate Chip.author: Sonal R.
Mint Chocolate Chip.text: Mint tastes like toothpaste and has an artificial aftertaste. Not good.

Mint Chocolate Chip.author: Aakash P.
Mint Chocolate Chip.text: Terrible. Overly sweet with a weird chemical aftertaste from the sweetener.

Mint Chocolate Chip.author: Diya M.
Mint Chocolate Chip.text: Refreshing mint with nice chocolate chips. I enjoyed it.

Mint Chocolate Chip.author: Nitin L.
Mint Chocolate Chip.text: Too few chocolate chips and the mint is very artificial. Disappointing.

Mint Chocolate Chip.author: Esha V.
Mint Chocolate Chip.text: Mint is overpowering and the chips are lacking. Average.

Tender Coconut.author: Arun K.
Tender Coconut.text: Very icy texture, more like frozen coconut water. Watery and bland.

Tender Coconut.author: Latha S.
Tender Coconut.text: Nice natural coconut flavour with bits of malai. Refreshing.

Tender Coconut.author: Hemant J.
Tender Coconut.text: Ice crystals throughout and the texture was grainy. Poor.

Tender Coconut.author: Preeti G.
Tender Coconut.text: Loved the fresh tender coconut taste. Light and lovely.

Tender Coconut.author: Sameer D.
Tender Coconut.text: The tub was dented and leaking when delivered. Poor packaging.

Kesar Pista.author: Geeta R.
Kesar Pista.text: Authentic kesar pista taste like traditional kulfi. Excellent.

Kesar Pista.author: Omkar S.
Kesar Pista.text: Nice rich flavour with real pista pieces. Good.

Kesar Pista.author: Rashmi T.
Kesar Pista.text: Kulfi stick is tiny and pricey for what you get.

Kesar Pista.author: Vivek M.
Kesar Pista.text: Saffron flavour is artificial and too sweet. Not like real kulfi.

Red Velvet.author: Tanya B.
Red Velvet.text: Overpriced. Too expensive for what is basically vanilla with colour.

Red Velvet.author: Rajat K.
Red Velvet.text: Pretty and tasty, nice cream cheese swirl.

Red Velvet.author: Mansi L.
Red Velvet.text: Bland and disappointing, cake pieces were soggy.

Red Velvet.author: Ayaan R.
Red Velvet.text: Not worth the premium price. Would buy only on discount.

Butterscotch Crunch.author: Suresh P.
Butterscotch Crunch.text: Classic butterscotch with great crunch. Tastes just like the full sugar version. Loved it.

Butterscotch Crunch.author: Kriti A.
Butterscotch Crunch.text: Good value for money, tasty and creamy.

Butterscotch Crunch.author: Dev S.
Butterscotch Crunch.text: The praline bits were sticky and chewy. Meh.

Butterscotch Crunch.author: Aparna N.
Butterscotch Crunch.text: Yummy and affordable. Perfect family pack.

Choco Almond.author: Rohit B.
Choco Almond.text: Crunchy almond coating and smooth chocolate inside. Excellent snack.

Choco Almond.author: Sanya K.
Choco Almond.text: Very tasty stick, tastes premium. Good for portion control.

Choco Almond.author: Irfan M.
Choco Almond.text: Coating cracked and fell off, the box was crushed during delivery.

Choco Almond.author: Nidhi T.
Choco Almond.text: Love these! Perfect guilt-free dessert after dinner.

Choco Almond.author: Chirag V.
Choco Almond.text: The multipack is pricey and expensive compared to single sticks.
